Fetch squad market values from Transfermarkt

Source: R/data_transfers.R
fetch_squad_values.Rd

Fetch squad market values from Transfermarkt

Usage

fetch_squad_values(country, start_year = 2024L)

Arguments

country

Character. Country name.

start_year

Integer. Season start year.

Value

A tibble with team names and squad values.

See also

Other data-acquisition: download_all_fd(), download_fd_csv(), fetch_fbref_all(), fetch_fbref_matches(), fetch_league_injuries(), fetch_league_suspensions(), fetch_league_transfers(), join_xg_to_matches(), parse_fd_csv(), parse_fd_odds()
